assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and a significant history of transient ischemic attacks.
The patient has a diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a history of transient ischemic attacks (G45.9).
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is ordered.
The service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indications of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and transient ischemic attacks.
